en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town's main street or square. Two rows of 2–3‑story houses with steep tiled roofs and shuttered windows line both sides of the street. In the center is a landscaped green with small bushes and trees, enclosed by low fences. A tall commemorative column with an eagle sculpture on top stands prominently in the middle of the green, surrounded by a small iron fence and a pedestal bearing an inscription. In the background rises a large medieval church or town‑hall–like building with multiple steep gables and tower spires. A few pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks.
